prompts.prompt: On F5 BIG-IP 17.1 and later, what is the minimum TLS version enforced for management interfaces like the Configuration Utility GUI and iControl REST? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/f5-bigip/references/versions/17.5.md - BIG-IP 17.1+ enforces TLS 1.2 as the minimum protocol version for all management interfaces

prompts.prompt: On BIG-IP 17.x hardware platforms equipped with a FIPS HSM (r-series, i-series), what FIPS 140 compliance level do they support? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/f5-bigip/references/versions/17.5.md - BIG-IP 17.x FIPS-equipped platforms support FIPS 140-2 Level 2, up from Level 1 in 15.x/16.x

prompts.prompt: In an F5 BIG-IP iRule, which event fires the moment a new TCP connection from the client is accepted, before any HTTP parsing occurs? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/f5-bigip/SKILL.md - iRules event model table lists CLIENT_ACCEPTED as the trigger for a new TCP connection from client
